---
title: "Events and callbacks"
description: "Run lightweight code when game events happen or on a regular update."
---

Use events for state changes and callbacks for work that needs to run repeatedly. Keep handlers small; high-frequency events and update callbacks run alongside the rotation.

## Game events

`RegisterNormalEvent` receives the normal event arguments from the game:

```lua
local function onTargetChanged()
  local target = warden.UnitManager:Get("target")
  if target.exists and target.enemy then
    -- Refresh target-specific state.
  end
end

warden.EventHandler:RegisterNormalEvent("PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED", onTargetChanged)
```

Remove a handler when the package no longer needs it:

```lua
warden.EventHandler:UnregisterNormalEvent("PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED", onTargetChanged)
```

## Combat-log events

`RegisterEvent` receives a structured event object. The event name is in `eventData.event`; source and destination units are in `eventData.source` and `eventData.dest`; spell-specific values are in `eventData.params`.

```lua
warden.EventHandler:RegisterEvent("SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS", function(eventData)
  local player = warden.UnitManager:Get("player")
  if eventData.source and eventData.source.guid == player.guid then
    local spellID = eventData.params[1]
    -- Record or react to the player's cast.
  end
end)
```

Use a filter when only some events should reach the handler:

```lua
warden.EventHandler:AddFilter("SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS", function(eventData)
  local player = warden.UnitManager:Get("player")
  return eventData.source and eventData.source.guid == player.guid
end)
```

Common combat-log events include `SPELL_CAST_START`, `SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS`, `SPELL_AURA_APPLIED`, `SPELL_AURA_REMOVED`, `SPELL_INTERRUPT`, and `SPELL_DISPEL`.

## Update and tick callbacks

Use `OnUpdate` for work tied to frame updates and `OnTick` for routine-style work. Store the returned callback ID if the callback needs to be removed later:

```lua
local callbackID = warden:OnUpdate(function(elapsed)
  -- Keep this light. `elapsed` is the time since the previous update.
end, true)

warden:RemoveCallback(callbackID, true)
```

Pass `false` to register a callback disabled, then enable it through the callback state when the package needs it. Avoid doing full enemy scans or printing to chat every frame.
